fusions.name: Second Helpings
fusions.desc: Gnaws with your weapon for 7 damage, making the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Clean the Plate
fusions.desc: Wolfs down a target at or below 25% health for 20 damage, plus 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it, which are used up. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shared Bowl
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second for 6 seconds. It grows 10% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Scraps for All
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
